talking_points: **Network-adequacy risk:** 3 solo primary-care physicians (age ~66+) in Wyoming are actively winding down. Several sit in ZIPs with no nearby backup, risking drive-time compliance gaps.

**Facility-fee shield:** ~430 Medicare patients are attached to these winding-down practices today. If they drift into hospital-owned clinics, the plan pays 2-3x more per identical visit via facility fees. Corner NPs capture those panels at 85-95% of the physician fee schedule — a direct cost-containment shield.

**Immediate ask:** fast-track credentialing for Corner in Wyoming; 3 practice(s) are the highest priority (winding down with little local backup) and ~10,800 patients sit across all 9 at-risk solo practices statewide.
